name: oss-bench
description:
This is the dataset for OSS-Bench
This dataset contains the experimental data for OSS-Bench(php) and OSS-Bench(sql) benchmarks, including:

Extracted function list from OSS
LLMs improved version for each function
Compilation results and logs
Test results and logs (php testlog is in php-src.zip, sqlite testlog is too large, separately stored in sqlite_testlogs.zip)
Collection of sanitizer alerts
Extended fuzzing results for GPT-O1 and Qwen-30B-A3B

Our website: https://oss-bench.github.io/
Our… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/0599jiangyc/oss-bench.
reputation: A specialized dataset used in research on LLM-driven code repair, compilation and fuzzing for real-world OSS projects; moderately recognized in the software-LLM evaluation community.
